title: WODwrist WOD
description: What the watch consumes. Produced by the text parser (watch or web editor) or written by hand. Derived fields (timeCapSec for EMOM/TABATA, rounds for FOR_TIME) are recomputed by the validator.

name.description: Shown in menus and saved in the FIT file (max 31 chars kept).

timeCapSec.description: AMRAP: duration (required). FOR_TIME: optional cap. EMOM/TABATA: total duration (derived).

intervalSec.description: EMOM: interval length (60 for EMOM, 120 for E2MOM). TABATA: workSec + restSec (derived).

rounds.description: EMOM: number of intervals. TABATA: number of rounds (default 8). FOR_TIME: rounds (default 1, or repScheme length). AMRAP: null.

repScheme.description: FOR_TIME, e.g. [21, 15, 9], or AMRAP ladder. Blocks with reps = 0 take the round's value.

repStep.description: AMRAP with repScheme: open ladder, add this after the last value each round (3-6-9-... -> 3). EMOM: Death by, the target of each block grows by this every interval and the WOD ends at the first missed interval.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the catalog name.

reps.description: Target in `unit`. 0 = max effort / take from repScheme.

slot.description: EMOM/TABATA: blocks with the same slot are done in the same interval; slots rotate in ascending order. null for AMRAP/FOR_TIME.
